subject: Remove an unnecessary check that seems to overflow in 32-bit
reason: The diff only modifies the project's own C unit test (src/unit/test_hashtable.c), deleting two TEST_ASSERT range checks on a pointer in test_random_entry_sparse_table that could overflow on 32-bit. No server code, command behaviour, replication, persistence or tool code changes, so there is no observable runtime behaviour for a scenario to exercise; the change is covered by simply building and running the unit tests.
